title: Against those who say the soul is blood
pass_a_gloss: Against all who say the soul is a body, and in particular against those who hold that the soul is blood or breath. If soul were blood, then as much blood as there is would be soul. But blood is generated and altered with food; it becomes flesh and the other parts. Soul is not divided and poured out as blood is. Therefore it is better to say that blood is not the soul, even if some creatures seem bloodless yet alive. The soul uses bodily stuff; it is not identical with blood.
pass_b_english: Some make the soul a body, and some of them name it blood (or breath). If soul were simply blood, quantity of blood would be quantity of soul. Yet blood is made from food and passes into flesh and the body's other parts; it is poured and divided. The soul is not emptied out that way. Even living things that seem without blood show that life is not the same as blood. Blood may serve life; it is not what the soul is.
